description: This file defines API routes related to user authentication using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for user registration, login, and fetching current user information, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance for grouping authentication-related API endpoints.

methods.name: UserOut register(payload: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user record in the database.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: UserLogin, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a JWT token upon success.

methods.name: UserOut me(current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the currently authenticated user's profile information.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: UserLogin, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> TokenResponse:$/

ctags.name: register
ctags.pattern: /^def register(payload: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> UserOut:$/
